title: It's a Wonderful Life
synopsis: A small-town banker on a bridge, an angel earning his wings, and a Christmas Eve that becomes a ledger of every kindness you forgot doing.

nodes.text: Mr. Gower has a telegram in one hand and gin on his breath.

choices.consequence: “Hold the capsules” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Brave.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Loyal.

nodes.text: The whole town files past with what they can spare. Harry toasts you. A bell rings. Zuzu says it means an angel got his wings.
You sit on the floor with the children and you do not look at the basket of money for a long time. You just look at them.
Across town, an old man in a wheelchair sits with a stolen bundle on his desk and does not, for the first time, count it.
